Description: Trusted 1origin public Nuxt preview pilot. Separate production storage and build role.

Properties.FunctionCode: function handler(event) { var r = event.request; if (r.uri.endsWith('/')) r.uri += 'index.html'; else if (!r.uri.split('/').pop().includes('.')) r.uri += '/index.html'; return r; }

Source.BuildSpec: {"version": "0.2", "phases": {"install": {"runtime-versions": {"nodejs": 22}, "commands": ["set -eu", "node -e 'if(!/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(process.env.COMMIT_SHA||\"\") || !/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/.test(process.env.PREVIEW_ID||\"\")) process.exit(1)'", "git init source", "git -C source remote add origin https://github.com/examplessdk-lgtm/1origin.git", "git -C source fetch --depth=1 origin \"$COMMIT_SHA\"", "git -C source checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD", "test \"$(git -C source rev-parse HEAD)\" = \"$COMMIT_SHA\"", "cd source/ui/nuxt", "npm ci --no-audit --no-fund"]}, "build": {"commands": ["NUXT_APP_BASE_URL=\"/previews/$PREVIEW_ID/\" npm run generate", "test -s .output/public/index.html"]}, "post_build": {"commands": ["test \"$CODEBUILD_BUILD_SUCCEEDING\" = \"1\""]}}, "artifacts": {"base-directory": "source/ui/nuxt/.output/public", "files": ["**/*"], "discard-paths": "no"}}
